import Mathlib

theorem p07 (n : ℕ) (h : 3 ≤ n) : 2 * n < 2 ^ n := by
  induction n, h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
      norm_num
  | succ n hn ih =>
      calc
        2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 := by omega
        _ < 2 ^ n + 2 ^ n := by omega
        _ = 2 ^ (n + 1) := by
          rw [pow_succ]
          omega
